opening:
It's backward if my brother says forward.
Left if he says right.
"Forward, forward, forward."
I can no longer hear my brother's voice.
I know I won't live much longer either.
solution: I am blind. My brother's head grows from the back of my neck. Since childhood, I have relied on my brother's guidance to live. But the defect caused my brother to have a mental breakdown. One day, my brother told me to keep walking forward. I gradually stepped backward, and my brother struck a sharp object, ending his painful life. Without my brother's care, I have no ability to take care of myself, so I know I won't live much longer.
canonical_facts: The brother's head grows from the back of the narrator's neck.
The narrator has relied on the brother's guidance since childhood.
The brother suffered a mental breakdown.
The brother instructed the narrator to keep walking forward.
The resulting backward movement caused the brother to strike a sharp object.
The narrator cannot care for themself without the brother.
